context: A screenshot of ghent-live, a 3D map of the historic centre of Ghent (Belgium) rendered in a web browser, centred on the Belfry (the red ring). This view shows the parking layer: each parking garage in the centre is drawn as a vertical column standing on the map, whose height is the garage's capacity and whose solid lower part is its occupied places. Other layers (buildings, water) may not be drawn yet; a plain ground grid stands in for the city.

checks.name: columns_of_different_heights
checks.instructions: Columns of different heights stand in the city: several vertical columns are visible on the map, and they are not all the same height.

checks.name: columns_partly_filled
checks.instructions: The columns are partly filled: each column has a solid, opaque lower part and an emptier, transparent or outlined part above it up to its top.

checks.name: selected_garage_labelled
checks.instructions: One column is highlighted, with a label above it that names a parking garage and its number of free places.
